name: Typewriter Push-Up
instructions: Begin in a push-up position with hands placed wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body down, shifting your weight to one side.
Keep your body low to the ground and shift horizontally across to the other side.
Your chest should stay close to the ground as you slide from one side to the other.
Push up from the opposite side.
Repeat the movement, alternating the direction of the typewriter motion.
Keep your core engaged and maintain a straight body line throughout.
This movement mimics the motion of an old typewriter carriage.
